title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-19

ai_review.summary: Audience tape of a late‑1973 show delivers an epic Here Comes Sunshine and killer segues despite rough sound quality.
ai_review.review: The performance is hailed as one of the best of ’73, with a smoking Here Comes Sunshine, a remarkable Truckin'→Nobody's Fault But Mine→Other One sequence and a standout Half Step.  The audience recording is damaged and a bit muddy, but it remains listenable and captures the full concert that many fans consider an all‑timer.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and praise the musical performance heavily; recording quality is noted as flawed but still usable, yielding a solid overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape shows heat/water damage, rough aud and occasional drop‑outs (stealth recording), but is listenable and captures the full set.

standout_songs: Truckin' → Nobody's Fault But Mine → Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid overall but a weaker Playin', while the second set shines with seamless segues and powerful jams, especially the Truckin'‑Nobody's Fault‑Other One chain.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass solo is noted when present; Phil Lesh later disallowed his bass solo for this night.
